rec.name: Bestsellers with Category Tabs

what.text: A custom Shopify section that shows a bold heading (e.g. "OUR BESTSELLERS") above clickable category tabs (e.g. T-Shirts, Hoodies, Sweaters, Pants). Clicking a tab swaps the product grid to that category's bestsellers without a page reload. Each product card shows the image, title (e.g. BASIC HOODIE), colour name with a colour-count hint ("BLACK (+21 colors)"), the price and a bookmark/wishlist icon. A "MEHR ENTDECKEN" (discover more) button sits below the grid.

why.text: Showing top sellers is social proof: shoppers trust what others buy. Category tabs let visitors jump straight to the product type they want without leaving the page, which cuts clicks and decision effort. The colour-count hint signals a wide range, and the wishlist icon lets undecided shoppers save items. The CTA button below the grid leads on to the full collection.

how.text: Build it as a custom section (ed-cro-featured-collections.liquid) where each section block is one tab. A block takes a collection (and an optional custom tab label), and the tab label falls back to the collection title. The tabs are a JS-driven component that toggles the matching tab panel (no reload) and animates a sliding underline indicator under the active tab. The tab bar scrolls horizontally on mobile. Products render in a grid with 2 columns on mobile and up to 4 on desktop. Colours, spacing and max-width are configured in the theme editor. Add the section to a template and assign one collection (e.g. a bestseller-sorted collection) per tab block. It was tested on the Focal theme (which has a similar default section) and on Dawn.

items: Show add to cart below product info
Colours: text, background, button background, button text (transparent = theme default)
Section spacing: top, bottom, left, right (desktop and mobile separately)
Blocks: one per tab, each with a collection and optional custom label

dependencies.text: Requires the Focal-theme CSS variables and classes (e.g. --grid-gap, --container-gutter, product-item, product-list). The code was also tested on the Dawn-based theme (Sectionfy.io). The wishlist/bookmark icon and the "+N colors" hint are shown in the final design but the supplied code excerpt does not include them, so a wishlist app or custom code is presumably needed. One collection per tab is needed, ideally sorted by best selling. The provided code is truncated, so the product-card markup is not visible.

items: Click-through to the collection via the CTA button

images.caption: Final mobile design: bold "UNSERE BESTSELLER" heading, tabs with the active tab (Hoodies) bold and underlined, 2-column product cards with title, colour (+21 colors), price and bookmark icon, and a black "MEHR ENTDECKEN" button.
Theme editor view of the built section with the tab blocks (one collection per tab) and settings for heading, products to show, products per row, colours and spacing.
